quorum.kill_rule: any un-countered substantive objection kills the claim
refuted_claims: Route WorkspaceHandler through the joined resolver too — REFUTED: that handler enumerates state/ and joins itself; through the joined resolver its listing becomes the machine directories under the active workspace (the same double-join re-entered).

Bump pforge to get annotations on the wire — REFUTED: pforge 0.2.1's adapter is byte-identical; metadata() answers a bare ToolInfo::new that hard-sets annotations: None, so only an in-tree pmcp server fills the field.

Publishing outputSchema on the wire is a free extra (the first cut) — REFUTED by the branch's own adversarial review: MCP 2025-06-18 makes it an obligation to return structuredContent, pmcp 1.20 cannot, and every tools/call failed on @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.30.0; removed, with a pairing test in place of the presence test.
quorum.divergence: none: the probe lane and the agy lane agree; the agy lane attacked the double-join, the traversal marker, the enumerator, the hint derivation, the adapter's dispatch parity, the outputSchema reasoning and the docs deletion, and refuted each attack with file:line evidence
